# Chunghwa Telecom Wins The Asset Corporate Sustainability Leadership Awards’ Top Honor, the Jade Award; Only Taiwanese Company to Win for Six Consecutive Years Leading Sustainability into a New Chapter


2026/11/16


Chunghwa Telecom Co., Ltd. (“Chunghwa” or “the Company”) has again earned international recognition for its sustainability leadership, receiving the Jade Award, the highest honor of The Asset Corporate Sustainability Leadership Awards, for the sixth consecutive year. The Asset is a leading international financial magazine. The Company is the only Taiwanese enterprise to win this honor for six consecutive years in the Awards’ cross-border, cross-industry assessments.


Chunghwa Chairman Chih-Cheng Chien said, “The Company remains committed to its vision of becoming an international benchmark enterprise built upon sustainable development. The Company embeds sustainability into its corporate governance and business strategy, guided by three strategic pillars: ‘Digital Resilience, Smart Empowerment, and a Sustainable Future.’ It continues to convert sustainability into competitiveness and long-term growth momentum.”


The Asset Corporate Sustainability Leadership Awards, which are highly regarded in Asia, take the perspective of institutional investors and industry analysts. Each year, a professional judging panel conducts a comprehensive evaluation of listed companies in Asia across multiple dimensions, including financial performance, corporate governance, social responsibility, environmental responsibility, and investor relations. The Awards recognize companies that demonstrate outstanding ESG performance and transparency.


**Embedding Sustainability into Business Decisions: Advancing Revenue Growth and Decarbonization, Unlocking New Momentum through Digital Resilience**


Against a backdrop of global geopolitical and economic uncertainties, climate risks, and rapid advances in AI, Chunghwa President Rong-Shy Lin said, “Sustainability is not separate from the Company’s core business, but an integral consideration in business management and resource allocation. With oversight from the Board-level Sustainable Development and Strategy Committee, Chunghwa integrates sustainability goals into its business strategy, pursuing revenue growth while continuing to reduce carbon emissions. In 2025, the parent company’s revenue increased 10.7% compared with 2020, while its Scope 1 and Scope 2 greenhouse gas emissions fell 24.5% over the same period, from 790,000 metric tons of CO

e.”


Chunghwa has adopted the “Sea, Land, and Sky” strategy, spanning submarine cables, fiber and mobile networks, microwave communications, and satellites, to build a multi-layered, mutually redundant network infrastructure. This resilient architecture reduces the risk of business disruption internally and provides government and enterprise customers with reliable network services that support critical missions such as transportation dispatch, medical emergency response, public safety, and real-time information flow.


Building on its strong telecommunications foundation, Chunghwa is extending its strengths in networks, data centers, and ICT services into emerging growth areas in the AI era. The Company is actively expanding capabilities across internet data centers (IDC), AI data centers (AIDC), AI computing capacity, cloud services, cybersecurity, satellite communications, and integrated enterprise ICT solutions. This enables its infrastructure to serve not only as the backbone of telecommunications services, but also as a critical foundation for the AI-driven digital economy. By turning risks into opportunities, Chunghwa continues to strengthen its digital resilience and bring new momentum to long-term sustainable growth.


**Advancing Sustainability Governance and Global Alignment, Earning Continued Investor Recognition and Support**


Earlier this year, Chunghwa became one of the first companies in Taiwan to fully adopt the IFRS Sustainability Disclosure Standards (IFRS S1 and S2), one year ahead of the government’s required schedule. The Company also took the lead in publishing its 2025 Sustainability-Related Financial Information Section, which systematically discloses sustainability- and climate-related risks, opportunities, and financial effects. These efforts demonstrate Chunghwa’s leadership in transparency and alignment with international standards, while rigorous assessment and disclosure of financial risks strengthen the trust of investors, customers, and other stakeholders.


Wen-Hsin Hsu, Chunghwa’s Senior Executive Vice President and Chief Financial Officer, said, “The Company’s long-standing commitment to sustainability has continued to earn international recognition. Chunghwa has maintained MSCI’s highest AAA ESG rating for two consecutive years, and the proportion of shares held by ESG-focused investors has continued to grow, demonstrating the Company’s growing appeal to ESG-oriented capital.”


Notably, Chunghwa has remained a constituent of the Dow Jones Best-in-Class World Index (DJBIC), has continued to rank among the global top 5% of companies in the S&P Global Sustainability Yearbook, and was recently named to TIME’s World’s Most Sustainable Companies list, placing it in the global top 1%. Winning The Asset’s highest honor, the Jade Award, for the sixth time demonstrates how sustainability governance translates into long-term competitiveness and marks another ESG milestone for the Company.
